"""Audit immutable checkpoint250 while the original production worker continues."""

import json
from pathlib import Path

import torch
from train_directional_bank_trial import guard, read, ref, save

repo = Path('/home/dllu/proj/demosaic')
root = repo / '.cache/quality-20261103/V154-robust-spectral-v1'
plan = read(root / 'plan-v1.json')
guard(plan)
previous = Path(plan['previous'])
complete = [json.loads(s) for s in (root / 'train-trace-v1.jsonl').read_bytes().splitlines(keepends=True) if s.endswith(b'\n')]
assert len(complete) > 250
path = root / 'checkpoints/train-step0250.pt'
old_path = previous / 'checkpoints/train-step0250.pt'
binding, old_binding = ref(path), ref(old_path)
state = torch.load(path, map_location='cpu', weights_only=True)
old = torch.load(old_path, map_location='cpu', weights_only=True)
assert state['step'] == old['step'] == 250
assert state['parent'] == old['parent'] == plan['parent']
arms = ['mse-control', 'charb-0p01', 'charb-0p003']
assert state['counts'] == state['updates'] == dict.fromkeys(arms, 250)
finite = 0
for arm in arms:
    assert len(state['models'][arm]) == len(state['emas'][arm]) == 13
    assert sum(v.numel() for v in state['models'][arm].values()) == 33713
    assert all(torch.isfinite(v).all() for key in ['models', 'emas'] for v in state[key][arm].values())
    adam = state['optimizers'][arm]['state']
    assert len(adam) == 13
    for values in adam.values():
        assert float(values['step']) == 250
        assert all(torch.isfinite(v).all() for v in values.values() if torch.is_tensor(v))
        finite += 1
for key in ['models', 'emas']:
    a, b = state[key]['mse-control'], old[key]['delivered-RGB']
    assert a.keys() == b.keys() and all(torch.equal(a[k], b[k]) for k in a)
a, b = state['optimizers']['mse-control'], old['optimizers']['delivered-RGB']
assert a['param_groups'] == b['param_groups'] and a['state'].keys() == b['state'].keys()
for key, values in a['state'].items():
    assert values.keys() == b['state'][key].keys()
    assert all(torch.equal(v, b['state'][key][k]) if torch.is_tensor(v) else v == b['state'][key][k]
               for k, v in values.items())
archived = read(plan['baseline_training']['path'])['trace']
for row, old_row in zip(complete[:250], archived[:250], strict=True):
    assert row['step'] == old_row['step'] and row['batch'] == old_row['batch']
    assert row['domain'] == old_row['domain']
    assert row['arms']['mse-control'] == old_row['arms']['delivered-RGB']
assert ref(path) == binding and ref(old_path) == old_binding
assert finite == 39 and not torch.cuda.is_initialized()
save(root / 'checkpoint250-audit-v1.json', {
    'status': 'pass-three-finite-checkpoint250-states-and-exact-mse-control',
    'checkpoint': binding, 'old_V153_checkpoint': old_binding,
    'finite_Adam_states': 39, 'control_raw_EMA_Adam_exact': True,
    'control_first250_trace_rows_exact': True,
    'auditor': dict(ref(Path(__file__)), text=Path(__file__).read_text()),
    'new_neural_forwards': 0, 'new_noise_draws': 0, 'CUDA_initialized': False,
    'scope': 'Reads completed immutable checkpoint250 after at least251 journal rows. All three arms have finite raw/EMA/Adam states and250 clocks. Pre-control exactly matches V153 delivered-RGB states and trace. Does not stop, replace or restart active training; no endpoint quality or later-state claim.',
})
print('PASS: 39 finite Adam states at250; mse-control raw/EMA/Adam and first250 trace rows exactV153')
